description: Use this when the user needs a date N working days from another date: delivery and shipping estimates, payment or settlement terms, notice periods, SLA and deadline questions. Skips weekends and the public holidays of the country or region, reports exactly which days were skipped, and flags any date in the range that independent sources disagree about.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AU, US, GB.

days.description: Business days to move. Positive counts forward, negative counts backward. Maximum magnitude 1000.

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision code such as AU-NSW or US-CA.

start_date.description: The starting date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It is not counted itself.

name: add_business_days
title: Add or subtract business days from a date
